verdict.rationale: Heap documents a Session Replay product with event-cued playback and sharing (heap-docs-20, heap-docs-21), but pricing lists it only as an add-on (heap-docs-26, heap-docs-27). The replay page says sensitive information can be excluded (heap-docs-22), yet the documented masking mechanisms are opt-in: heap-ignore and disableTextCapture (heap-docs-13, heap-docs-14), with the **** redaction described for the analytics dataset rather than replays (heap-docs-12). missing for 10: evidence that input masking is on by default in replays, replay-specific privacy docs, independent or hands-on corroboration, and inclusion in base plans rather than as an add-on.
